Title: A Gentle Hello in the Desert

Duration: 15 seconds

Format: 16:9 horizontal

Cinematic Style: Hand-painted watercolor and gouache storybook animation matching the current Magic English Voyage art direction, adapted for the desert map. Warm cream sunlight, soft sand and clay earth tones, pale mint-green oasis plants, tiny coral-pink accents, soft pencil outlines, visible paper grain, low-saturation colors, gentle imperfect brush texture, cozy quiet emotion. Characters should look warm, clean, attractive, and child-safe: bright clean eyes, soft cheeks, balanced proportions, gentle smiles, refined hand-painted character design. It must feel hand-drawn and alive, not glossy 3D or plastic CGI.

Source Situation: Two young children meet on a quiet desert-oasis path for the first time. One child feels a little shy, then bravely waves and says hello. The other child answers warmly. The meaning of the English expression "Hello" must be visually clear through waving, eye contact, smiling, and friendly greeting. No classroom, no flashcards, no written labels.

CEFR Target: Pre-A1 / very young A1. The target English expression is "Hello". Keep every spoken line short, natural, and easy for a young English learner to understand. The word "Hello" must be heard clearly several times, but it should sound like real friendly greeting, not a vocabulary drill.
